title: Basix Engine evidence library
purpose: Support MIT engine architecture and future rendering implementation.
scope: UE5.8/6, NoGraphicsAPI, PETAFAB, DXR/DX12, Linear Algebra, RTXDI/RTXPT and DLSS.
summary: Initial CPU/GPU foundation and scoped lifecycle/window tests have local correctness evidence; advanced rendering ideas are separately labeled proposals or author reports.
Actual static DLSS SR interoperability passes8cases with a measured descriptor-state workaround; temporal renderer quality remains unverified.
Vulkan-first adoption map separates native extension contracts, portable replacements and enumeration/enabling/oracle/performance evidence; no advanced-extension execution measurements added.
M2 partial: tested material CPU/GPU evaluation and CPU progressive reference; Vulkan advanced feature queries recorded separately from execution.
Scoped progressive Vulkan PT passes11 cases; GPU sampling remains partial with18 retained grazing failures and maximum paired transport-weight discrepancy15.688%.
Distinct visible-GGX sampled-state proposal passes canonical sampling and fixed-scene transport gates; legacy NDF grazing failures remain recorded and broader M2 stays partial.

findings.context: 2026-10-28; original MIT CPU/Slang implementation; Windows RTX4090/NVIDIA617.42 is the tested GPU configuration.

findings.implications: Keep legacy and visible-normal contracts separate; only adopt after the selected sampling and scene gates pass. Continue thin-gap/coordinate and scene/guide acceptance while keeping M2 partial.
